meta.title: Sign in to Xynes
meta.description: One account. Every Xynes workspace and console.

hero.headline: Sign in to Xynes.
hero.subhead: One account, every Xynes workspace and console — no second password, no extra setup.
hero.footnote: No credit card required. No tracking cookies.

workspaceScoped.headline: Workspace-scoped access
workspaceScoped.body: Sign in once, switch workspaces without losing context. Permissions follow the workspace, not the user.

sso.headline: Single sign-on across Xynes apps
sso.body: Sign in here, land in the CMS, the storage console, or any future Xynes app without re-authenticating.

openSource.headline: Open source, audited
openSource.body: Every line of the auth flow is open source. Every release ships with a published security policy and a third-party audit cadence.

footer.copyright: © 2026 Xynes Studio. Built in the open.

cookie.message: We use a session cookie for sign-in. No tracking cookies.
